text:
Multiple sockets can be connected to the mains electricity supply so that a lot of appliances can
use the same socket.
Why can this be a problem?
A
The current in each appliance may not be enough for it to work correctly.
B
The potential difference (p.d.) across each appliance may not be enough for it to
work correctly.
C
The total current may be large and cause overheating or a fire.
D
The total potential difference (p.d.) may be large and cause overheating or a fire.
